profile.headline: Software Engineer at American Express

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted from Software Engineer I → II → III

Played a key role in modernizing card reinstatement system by designing and implementing distributed services, enabling migration from legacy mainframe architecture to scalable cloud-based solution

Led architecture initiatives impacting 15+ engineering teams, driving design reviews, defining platform standards, and building reusable components to support large-scale system migrations

Developed a Couchbase client supporting SDK migration, including multi-cluster routing and failover logic, improving system resilience and availability

Built secure, high-throughput backend services handling 3M+ requests per month, supporting critical credit workflows

Optimized IPM batch processing, reducing daily runtime by nearly 4 hours

Led disaster recovery exercises, strengthening system resiliency and improving incident readiness across critical services

Upgraded multiple front-end application modules to modern frameworks, improving performance, maintainability, and developer productivity

Mentored early-career engineers through onboarding cohorts, supporting technical growth and integration

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built automation tools and POCs that eliminated manual workflows, saving ~$120k annually

Collaborated in Agile team across dev, lead, and PM roles; presented progress to engineering leadership

Developed features using Python, Docker, React, and Couchbase across projects involving machine learning, automation, voice recognition, and sentiment analysis

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - COP 2271: Computer Programming for Engineers
positions.description:
Supported 280+ students via office hours, grading, and instruction in MATLAB programming

Co-developed grading rubrics and identified learning gaps to improve course delivery

positions.title: Math Instructor
positions.description: Tutored students ranging from Kindergarten to 12th grade, teaching them an individualized curriculum as well as assisting with their schoolwork.

honors.title: Knox Millsaps Memorial Endowment Fund Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by UF Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering · Mar 2018

honors.title: University of Florida President's Honor Roll
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Florida · Feb 2018

projects.title: Gator Game Jam (Hackathon) - 1st Place Finish
projects.description: Winner of “Best in Show” and “People’s Choice Award”. Developed astronaut survival game in 40 hours, writing scripts in C# and utilizing Unity 2D software. Worked as a software developer in a team of four, including programmers, game designers, and artists.

projects.title: Arcade-Style Spaceship Computer Game
projects.description: Developed a 2D shooting game inspired by Bosconian and Star Wars using Processing language. Worked on a team of two, using GitHub for version control and meeting weekly to discuss progress.
